description.p: PassCall turns a display with a camera into a window between two homes. When you and a friend both walk past your screens at the same time, the window opens and you see each other. There are no calls to make, no feed, no ads and no recording.

This package is the Linux launcher. It opens the PassCall web app in a browser window of its own, with a separate browser profile, and keeps the machine awake while the window is open. Kiosk mode starts the window full screen at login, for an old laptop or small PC that lives on a shelf.
Needs Chromium, Google Chrome, Brave or Firefox. A free PassCall account is required; friends are added by email address and only people who have added each other can ever see one another.
